one_line: Open with a direct question to the buyer, then unbox and flip through the product top-down.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 eye-level selfie in a living room, mouth closed. Pink-outlined text: "הוצה לראות איך ילדים בני 3 לומדים צבעים צורות ומספרים באפס מאמץ מצידך?". Voice (transcript): "את גננת, אמא לילדים?". 0:02 cut to a closed box.
q1_hook.why: A question naming the buyers, a gan teacher or a mother, with a face and a text promise at once (H1, H4, H6). "Zero effort" is a clear benefit (H2). But the 12-word card has a typo and the mouth is closed while the voice starts, so face and voice feel apart (T3).

beats.what: Creator's face; four-line text question; voice "את גננת, אמא לילדים?"
beats.why: Names the viewer and the promise

beats.what: Top-down: closed box "מזהים צבעים בכיף" opened, markers, eraser, instruction card
A hand flips through the 30 cards: flower, fish, colour wheel, shapes; "30 כרטיסי פעילות"
beats.why: Variety shown, but one long flip

beats.what: Wipe-off sleeve with spinner and markers, shapes card in a sleeve, sticker sheets, balloons card
Classroom: children's hands place dot stickers on grid cards
beats.why: First sight of real children using it

beats.what: Children draw on sleeves; "הערכה הזו בשבילך" (transcript)
beats.why: Spoken verdict while use is shown

beats.what: Spinner game and colouring, stamping and numbered pictures; no voice, no text
beats.why: Real use, but nothing explains it

beats.what: Her hand holds up finished sleeves above the closed box; children seated behind

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption only: "רוצה להכניס את הקסם הזה גם לגן שלך? כתבי לי כאן ואשלח את כל הפרטים". A rhetorical "איך מייצרים למידה חווייתית באמת?". Nothing in the video asks for a comment, send or save.
q2_flow.why: Each card flip brings a new picture (R3). But the 17 s card flip with a spoken contents list, and 22 s of children at work with no voice or text, are stretches with little new information (R3, R1). At 70 s it runs long for one kit (R2), and it ends on held-up sleeves, not a reaction (R4).

q3_cta.what: Spoken 0:41 to 0:48 (transcript): "אם את מעוניינת שילדך או ילדי הגן שלך ילמדו לזהות ולשיים צבעים בכיף, הערכה הזו בשבילך". Caption, near the end: "כתבי לי כאן ואשלח את כל הפרטים👇". The box shows a phone number.
q3_cta.why: One ask only, to write for details (C1). But the video says only "this kit is for you" and never shows the ask, which sits at the foot of a 200-word caption, under "more" (C6). The caption question is yes/no and no keyword is named (C5).

q4_shown.what: The creator's face 0:00 to 0:02 only. A closed box with title and phone number; markers, eraser, 30 cards flipped, sleeves, spinner, stickers; children's hands using the kit in a classroom 0:33 to 1:05; finished sleeves held up. No price.
q4_shown.why: The box is on screen at 0:02 and opened by 0:03 (S1). After the first 2 s only hands show, enough for a demo (S4). She is the maker, so her "מניסיון שלי בגן" is first-hand but not independent (S6). Children's faces appear in the background at the end (S5).

q5_edit.what: 12 shots by detection in 70 s, about 5.8 s each, but the 0:06 to 0:23 card flip is one long handheld take. Typed word-by-word subtitles from 0:03 to 0:47, then none. An "AutoCap" watermark bottom right from 0:02. Ends on held-up sleeves.
q5_edit.why: Few hard cuts and a 17 s flip slow the pace (E2). Voice with subtitles serves sound off for 47 s, but the last 22 s carry no message (E4). Another app's watermark stays on screen almost throughout (E7). It runs 22 s after the spoken verdict (E8).

q6_topic.what: A gan teacher's own colour-learning activity kit for about 3-year-olds, unboxed and shown in use; serves gan teachers and mothers wanting a reusable play set.
q6_topic.why: Learning colours is a real concern and the Reel names its buyers, teacher and mother (K6, K7). Caption claims such as "בונה חוויית הצלחה וביטחון עצמי אדיר" are strong, not modest (K4). It stays calm and instructional, with no peak (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Eye-level selfie for 2 s; handheld top-down over a brown table for the unboxing and card flip; handheld classroom shots over children's tables, with glare on the plastic sleeves; last shot at lap level.
q7_filmed.why: Vertical and homemade, with hands that put the viewer in the seat for the flip (F5). But an app watermark is visible (F3). Glare and shake hide the card text, which is unreadable at phone size (F7, F4).

q8_text.on_screen: 0:00 to 0:02 pink-outlined text, four lines: "הוצה לראות איך ילדים בני 3 לומדים צבעים צורות ומספרים באפס מאמץ מצידך?". 0:03 to 0:47 large white typed subtitles, one green word per chunk, lower third, in fragments: "בואי תכירי את הע" (0:05), "30 כרטיסי פעילות" (0:15). None after 0:48. "AutoCap" bottom right.
q8_text.caption: "בתור גננת ואמא,". About 200 words: a hook on experiential learning, a question, four emoji benefit bullets, "כתבי לי כאן ואשלח את כל הפרטים", then 8 hashtags (#גננות #חינוךלגילהרך ...). No disclosure line.
q8_text.why: A headline in the first second is the right move (T3), but it is a full sentence with a typo. Typed fragments like "הע" are hard to read (T2, T5). Subtitles and watermark sit in the lower area (T4). The first caption line names her role, good for search, but 8 hashtags exceed 5 (T7).

weak_points: An app watermark; 22 s with no voice or text at the end; a typo in the headline; typed fragment subtitles; 8 hashtags; the ask only in a long caption; glare on the cards.
lumebook_takeaway: Open with a question card over the box, unbox top-down, flip the book with short captions, hold up the result; export clean, with no app watermark.
not_verified: Whether the voice is lip-synced in 0:00 to 0:02 (mouth looks closed). Music. Whether the children are her pupils or her own. Corrections to coded file: the voiceover ends at 0:48, so the last 22 s have no voice or subtitles (the coded file says the voice is in the last 3 s); resolution is 576 x 1024.
